name: User info
summary: A person/identity row — an avatar next to a name, with an optional email underneath.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-user-info> — the identity row that pairs a person's picture with their name (and, optionally, their email). It REUSES the shared <aha-avatar> for the picture/initials; it never re-implements one. Two layouts fall out of the data: email present → a 40px avatar + name (14/600) over email (12/400); email omitted (or size="compact") → a 24px avatar + name only on one line. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. The name renders as real text; the avatar is decorative (aria-hidden) so the name carries the accessible identity. A purely static display marker, so it declares no motion. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin attribute wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design, reusing the shared aha-avatar.

spec.label: Compact
spec.value: size="compact" (or no email) → 24px avatar + name only

props.name: name
props.desc: The person's full name — rendered as text, and passed to the avatar for initials/alt

props.name: email
props.desc: Optional email; when present (and not compact) it renders under the name in the default layout

props.name: src
props.desc: Avatar image URL; falls through to initials of `name` when absent

props.name: size
props.desc: 'default' → 40px avatar + email row; 'compact' → 24px avatar + name only. Omitting `email` implies compact

whenToUse.when: showing a person's identity as a row — avatar + name (+ email): a member list, an author byline, an account switcher
just the picture/initials with no name text beside it
a labelled field grid about an entity, not a compact identity row

opinion.note: Always provide `name` — it's both the visible label and the avatar's initials/alt. Reach for User info over a plain Avatar whenever the name (and email) belong next to the face; reach for the bare Avatar when only the picture is wanted. Omit `email` (or set size="compact") for a tight one-line identity in menus and dense lists.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the DS V3 User info component (fileKey P764iQ6y4ZwW7W3f7FLZyW, node 2684:2721): Email=Yes shows avatar + name + email (40px avatar), Email=No shows avatar + name only (24px avatar). Name = 14px / SemiBold 600 / #1A1A1A (text-default); email = 12px / Regular 400 / #8A8A8A (text-secondary); gap 8. No visible card border (the dashed box in the mock is a Figma annotation) — spacing only. Reuses the shared Avatar for the picture/initials rather than re-drawing one.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe carries name + email so both text rows render; the measure asserts the name/email colours + sizes AND that a real <aha-avatar> (with its own shadowRoot) is nested — proving reuse, not a re-implemented avatar.
